notes: game_min_commit is the game commit that landed RL-6 (ashcrown-obs-v2, configurable observation). layout_hash pins the DEFAULT ashcrown-obs-v2 layout table (grid on, radius 10, perception 900, portal assist on, blocked off); any other observation config resolves to its own published layout_hash (RLSchema.layout_hash(config)) and verify_handshake compares the live handshake against this file unless an explicit expected_layout_hash override is passed. observation_config is the default config every reset must match for its lifetime; grid_radius/perception_px are the accepted option windows. obs_clamp is the documented observation range. This file documents the target; the live handshake remains the compatibility authority.
